hypotheses.justification: The proof uses `hp` only once, to get `hr0 : 0 < ‖p n‖` for the `n` produced by `filter_upwards`. The conclusion is an eventual statement, so positivity of `‖p n‖` is only needed eventually. That already follows from `hr : Tendsto (fun n => ‖p n‖) atTop atTop`: `hr.eventually_gt_atTop 0` gives `∀ᶠ n in atTop, 0 < ‖p n‖`. The repaired proof is `filter_upwards [he, hr.eventually_gt_atTop 0] with n hn hr0`; every other step stays as it is. Finitely many indices with `p n = 0` cause no trouble: there `‖p n‖⁻¹ • p n = 0`, and the limit `ν` and the steps `hinv`, `hinner`, `hg` and `he` never use `p n ≠ 0`. Degenerate case: if every `p n` were `0`, then `hr` would fail because the norms do not tend to infinity, so the statement is vacuous there too.
